description: Transfer all solid solutes and exclude hollow magenta inhibitors. Move the selective pumps along the membrane and fire an ATP stroke for the incoming solutes. Each stroke spends one of four ATP, locks the selected height, extends for 0.4 seconds and opens briefly. Steering during a stroke queues the next height. The stroke cannot be cancelled. Each deliberate pump control advances one fixed 100ms pulse; waiting leaves particles and pumps unchanged. The pumps move during those pulses. One lost solute or admitted inhibitor ends the episode. Certification before completion also ends the episode. Inspect the chamber, then start perfusion. Solve only from screenshots and visible controls in the task webpage. Do not use code, scripts, automation, Developer Tools, console/debugger/inspector/network/source/DOM/page-state inspection, terminal/shell/Python, address-bar or URL/query edits, reload/navigation, browser extensions, external applications, hidden-state access, or unrelated tabs. Only task-created tabs and their visible controls are allowed.
